scenarios.purpose: Enumerate every river remaining after each compatible pair of private hands on a four-card board using a small no-raise tree.
Condition jointly on two selected rivers while exercising asymmetric stacks, multiple sizes, raises and all-in actions.
Nuts/air versus bluffcatcher, pot-size bet, finite tree
Weighted river range, two opening sizes, raises and unequal stacks

methodology.checkpoint_overhead: target=0 forces checks every 20 iterations and ordinarily runs to cap; compared with an otherwise identical fixed 300 solve.
methodology.limitations: Four synthetic turn/river fixtures, machine-specific timings, conditional runout subsets as specified by fixture; no claim of general equilibrium accuracy.
methodology.strategy_comparison: Adaptive strategy compared with a fixed-budget solve at the same actual iteration count; probability absolute difference.
methodology.target_units: Absolute exploitability in chips; fixture pot is 100, so 0.1 chips is 0.1% pot.
methodology.timing: Complete solve_postflop call; includes exact public-batched best-response checks and result assembly, excludes JSON serialization.
